changes: 🎰 Tier cosmetics now reach Roulette, Slots, and Hold'em — previously deliberately left out since a blanket hue-shift would've cheapened each game's own bespoke design (gold bezel, gold cabinet, embossed velvet felt). Instead, one tasteful accent per game: a tier-coloured glow on the Roulette ball itself, a tier-coloured rim on the Slots reel window, and Hold'em's "you" seat now reflects your real tier instead of always glowing brass. Pure CSS, reacts to the same tier state already tracked — no JS changes needed.
